# Paths reserved for an owner decision.
#
# The "Sensitive paths" workflow fails a pull request that changes any file
# listed here. The autonomous routines treat that failure as a HOLD signal:
# they leave the pull request open and ready and state the decision needed,
# instead of merging it. See docs/37-sensitive-path-check.md.
#
# Format: one repository-relative path per line. A trailing "/" matches every
# file under that directory; anything else matches that exact file. A leading
# "!" carves an exception out of a reserved directory. Globs are not
# supported. Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are ignored.
#
# Keep this list narrow. A path belongs here only if almost every change to it
# is an access-control, payment or public-contract decision; routine feature
# work that merely passes through a file does not.

# Authentication, sessions and access control
src/lib/auth.ts
src/lib/auth-client.ts
src/lib/auth-return-path.ts
src/app/api/auth/
src/proxy.ts
src/modules/identity/access-policy.ts
src/modules/identity/admin-access.ts
src/modules/businesses/permissions.ts
src/lib/database/schema/auth.ts

# Public business projection contract
src/modules/businesses/site-projection.ts

# Payments (no payment code exists yet; reserved so it is covered from day one)
src/modules/payments/

# CI, release and repository controls (includes this file and its workflow)
.github/
scripts/check-sensitive-paths.ts
railway.json

# Exception: every migration PR routinely bumps the expected migration count in
# this workflow, and the owner has authorised migrations to merge autonomously.
!.github/workflows/standard-postgres.yml
